Then post the report as required. 09/30/2025 4 (2nd Bullet) The Lead Agency does not describe how its policies to prevent the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5 in child care and other early childhood programs receiving CCDF funds are shared with families, providers, and the general public, as required by 98.33(b)(1)(v). (Plan Question 9.3.7a): MSDE will conduct surveys from the child care community requesting their current practices/policies regarding suspension and expulsion, including 07/31/2025 soft suspensions and expulsions, of children from birth to age 5 in child care and other early childhood. MSDE will also review and utilize Child Trends findings of providers' understanding of suspension and expulsion policy, based on the study they did as well. Overall Target Completion Date: December 5 (2nd Bullet) The Lead Agency does not describe how its policies to prevent the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5 in child care and other early childhood programs receiving CCDF funds are shared with families, providers, and the general public, as required by 98.33(b)(1)(v). (Plan Question 9.3.7a): Based on the feedback received, MSDE would then do some research and request TA from other states (and other school readiness divisions in MSDE) as to what practices they utilize to prevent the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5 in child care and other early childhood. 12/31/2025 6 (2nd Bullet) The Lead Agency does not describe how its policies to prevent the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5 in child care and other early childhood programs receiving CCDF funds are shared with families, providers, and the general public, as required by 98.33(b)(1)(v). (Plan Question 9.3.7a): Based on the ACF TA received, MSDE will then draft its own policy regarding the prevention of the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5. The drafted policies would then be shared with stakeholders for feedback. Edits and revisions to the drafted regulations will occur during this timeframe. The drafted policies would then be submitted to leadership and the Maryland State Board of Education and the Accountability Implementation Board for review and approval. 07/31/2026 7 (2nd Bullet) The Lead Agency does not describe how its policies to prevent the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5 in child care and other early childhood programs receiving CCDF funds are shared with families, providers, and the general public, as required by 98.33(b)(1)(v). (Plan Question 9.3.7a): MSDE will ensure to post information and policies in relation 12/31/2026 to the prevention of the suspension and expulsion of children from birth to age 5. and update staff and child care providers on the new policy, while educating providers on the topic via meetings and/or listening sessions. If a regulations amendment is required, MSDE would then follow suit with making regulations amendments as well, throughout the process. QUALITY IMPROVEMENT AND SUPPORT FOR CHILD CARE
